name: gallery
description: Disk-backed media gallery and workflow inspector. Scans folders directly, reads captions/.txt sidecars, SD prompts, and ComfyUI workflows from image metadata.
author: LainStable

volumes.description: Root folder that the gallery browses on disk (media, captions and metadata are read directly from here).

assistant_actions.name: scan_status
assistant_actions.description: Report gallery status for the configured media root (counts, optimize state).

assistant_actions.name: rescan_library
assistant_actions.description: Rescan the gallery library so new or removed media shows up.

assistant_actions.name: optimize_folder
assistant_actions.description: Optimize the images in a library folder (convert oversized files to the configured format).

params.name: folder
params.description: Folder path relative to the gallery root.
